Name: Combat Made Easy Suite (Content Patcher)
Author: Ericlegacy21
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/siKqdxu.png[/img]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b][u][i]Supported for Stardew Valley v1.6[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][b]Enhance your combat adventure![/b] Adjust monster difficulty (decrease/increase health, damage, speed), boost loot drop chances, and customize all weapon stats. Enjoy daily randomized combat buffs, ability to craft all rings, speed up machine processing, and much more! Tailor your thrilling experience. Happy Adventuring! :D

[b][u]See "List of Settings"[/u][/b] below to view all the options and features included with the mod!

[b][u]Translations are welcome![/u][/b]
If you or know of someone that would like to translate this mod, please release the translation that adds a i18n folder and link it back to this mod! 
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url]

[b][u]New to modding?[/u][/b]
Check out this modding guide for additional help and resources: 
[url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Modding:Player Guide/Getting Started - Stardew Valley Wiki[/url][/size]
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/vwkslyh.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][size=3][color=#ffff00][b]1.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿﻿

[color=#ffff00][b]2.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download and Extract the Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/url]

[color=#ffff00][b]3.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Download and Extract the Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿

[/url][color=#ffff00][b]4.[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4227?tab=files]Download and Extract the Combat Made Easy Suite mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/url]

[color=#ffff00][b]5.[/b] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]Launch Stardew Valley.[/color][color=#ffff00] [/color]To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the Stardew Valley title screen. All the settings will be there. Hover over the settings for full descriptions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hv28Y8r.jpg[/img]

[b][u]If you're using Steam[/u]: [/b][i]you can easily find your mods folder by going into your Steam Library, right click on Stardew Valley, click 'Manage', then 'Browse local files'. This will take you to your Stardew Valley directory that will have the mods folder there. That is where you will extract the contents of your mods.[/i][/size]
[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/PPFI0WR.png[/img]﻿[/size]

[size=3]Here's the list of settings included with Combat Made Easy Suite![/size]

[u][i][size=3]Click the spoiler button for the full list of settings:
[/size][/i][/u]
[spoiler]
[b][color=#e69138][size=4][u]COMBAT DIFFICULTY[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[size=3][u][b]Monsters Health[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will modify all monsters health. Ranges from 10% up to 99% for easy settings and 10% up to 300% for hard settings with a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge! The Lucky Health options will change monsters health based on daily luck on the TV.

[u][b]Damage Received[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will modify all damage received from monsters. Ranges from 10% up to 100% for easy settings and 10% to 300% for hard settings with a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge! The Lucky Damage options will change the damage received from monsters based on daily luck on the TV.

[u][b]Monsters Movement Speed[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease most monster's movement speed. Has a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge! Flying monsters will not be affected!

[u][b]Ground Monster Detection[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will make modify radius in which ground monsters will detect and start attacking the player. Has a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge!

[u][b]Flying Monster Detection[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will modify radius in which flying monsters will detect and start attacking the player. Has a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge!

[u][b]Combat Skill Experience Points[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the amount of experience points gained for your Combat Skill. Ranges from 1.5X to 10X increase.[/size]

[b][color=#e69138][size=4][u]MONSTER LOOT[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[size=3][u][b]Monster Loot Drops[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will multiply and/or increase the drop rate of items from all monsters. The Shared Loot Drops options will be shared by the same percentage you select. Will not work on the monsters in the Quarry Mine! Ranges from 2X to 64X increase or 1% to 99% for shared loot drops.

[u][b]Monsters Prismatic Shards[/b][/u]
-All monsters will now have a base 1% chance to drop a Prismatic Shard. The Monster Loot Drops settings will also affect the rate in which Prismatic Shards drop.

[b][color=#e69138][size=4][u]ADVENTURING BUFFS

[/u][/size][/color][/b][/size][size=3][u][b]Lucky Adventuring Buffs[/b][/u]
-Random combat and mining buffs will have a 20% chance to be activated as a passive buff every day. The stats of the buff will be randomized. To see which buffs are applied for the day, hover over the Blessing of Combat (Swords) buff at the top right of the screen while in game.[/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]WEAPON MODIFICATIONS[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][u][b]All Weapons Crit Chance[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that increases the critical chance for all weapons. Please note, changing this setting will only affect newly acquired weapons after the setting is enabled! Ranges from 5% to 99% chance.

[u][b]All Weapons Crit Multiplier[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that increases the critical multiplier for all weapons. Please note, changing this setting will only affect newly acquired weapons after the setting is enabled! Ranges from 4X to 30X multiplier.

[u][b]Slow Weapons Normal Speed[/b][/u]
-All slower weapons will now have a normal attack speed value.

[u][b]All Weapons Fast Speed[/b][/u]
-All weapons will now have a very fast attack speed value.

[u][b]Weapons Not Lost On Death[/b][/u]
-All weapons can no longer be lost on death.

[b][u]Gold/Iridium Scythe Damage[/u][/b]
-Gold and Iridium Scythe will now have normal attack values.[/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]LUCK FOOD BUFFS AND DURATIONS[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][u][b]Banana Pudding Duration[/b][/u]
-The Banana Pudding food item buffs will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Banana Pudding Buffs[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to stats for the Banana Pudding food item. Ranges from +2 to +25 level stat increases. Includes mining, luck, and defense boosts.

[u][b]Fried Eel Duration[/b][/u]
-The Fried Eel food item buff will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Fried Eel Buff[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to the luck stat for the Fried Eel food item. Ranges from +2 to +25 level stat increases. Includes a luck boost.

[u][b]Ginger Ale Duration[/b][/u]
-The Ginger Ale drink item buff will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Ginger Ale Buff[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to the luck stat for the Ginger Ale drink item. Ranges from +2 to +25 level stat increases. Includes a luck boost. Can be stacked with food buffs.

[u][b]Lucky Lunch Duration[/b][/u]
-The Lucky Lunch food item buff will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Lucky Lunch Buff[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to the luck stat for the Lucky Lunch food item. Ranges from +4 to +25 level stat increases. Includes a luck boost.

[u][b]Pumpkin Soup Duration[/b][/u]
-The Pumpkin Soup food item buffs will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Pumpkin Soup Buffs[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to stats for the Pumpkin Soup food item. Ranges from +3 to +25 level stat increases. Includes a luck and defense boosts.

[u][b]Spicy Eel Duration[/b][/u]
-The Spicy Eel food item buffs will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Spicy Eel Buffs[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to stats for the Spicy Eel food item. Ranges from +2 to +25 level stat increases. Includes a luck and speed boost. Speed is capped at a +10 boost.

[u][b]Magic Rock Candy Duration[/b][/u]
-The Magic Rock Candy food item buffs will now last an entire day.

[u][b]Magic Rock Candy Buffs[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the boost to stats for the Magic Rock Candy. Ranges from +1 to +25 level stat increases. Includes mining, luck, speed, attack, and defense boosts. Speed is capped at a +10 boost.[/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]CRAFTING AND RECIPES[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][u][b]All Bombs Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that lowers the amount of materials requirement to craft all bombs.

[u][b]Furnace Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will lower the requirements to craft a furnace.

[u][b]Charcoal Kiln Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will lower the requirements to craft a charcoal kiln.

[u][b]Crystalarium Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will lower the requirements to craft a crystalarium.

[u][b]Crystalarium Mining Level[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will lower the mining level requirement to craft the crystalarium.

[u][b]Geode Crusher Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will lower the requirements to craft a geode crusher.

[u][b]Monster Musk Ingredients[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft the Monster Musk item.

[u][b]Magic Rock Candy Recipe (REQ)[/b][/u]
-The Magic Rock Candy food item is now a cookable item learned at either Combat Level 9 or Level 1. This setting is required for the ingredients settings below!

[u][b]Magic Rock Candy Ingredients[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the ingredients required to cook the Magic Rock Candy. Requires the Magic Rock Candy Recipe (REQ) setting to work!

[u][b]Craft All Rings (REQ)[/b][/u]
-All rings in the game can now be crafted and learned at various combat skill levels. This setting is required for all ring settings below! If you're already at the required combat level for new recipes, you will learn the recipes automatically once this setting is enabled.

[u][b]All Rings Materials[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of materials required to craft all rings. Requires the Craft All Rings In The Game (REQ) setting to work!

[u][b]All Rings Combat Level 1[/b][/u]
-All ring recipes will now be Combat Level 1. Requires the Craft All Rings In The Game (REQ) setting to work![/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]ORES, BARS, AND MINERALS[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][u][b]Furnace Faster Bars[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that speeds up the production of bars from furnaces.

[u][b]Furnace Ore Requirement[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the amount of ore required to create bars.

[u][b]Furnace No Coal[/b][/u]
-Furnaces will no longer require a piece of coal to make bars.

[u][b]Charcoal Kiln Faster Coal[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that speeds up the production of coal from charcoal kilns.

[u][b]Charcoal Kiln More Coal[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting increases the amount of ore obtained from the Charcoal Kiln.

[u][b]Charcoal Kiln Wood[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that decreases or increases the amount of wood that's required to produce coal from the Charcoal Kiln.

[u][b]Geode Crusher Faster[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that speeds up the crushing of geodes in the geode crusher.

[u][b]Crystalarium Faster Gems[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that speeds up the production of gems from crystalariums.

[u][b]Crystalarium Prismatic Shards[/b][/u]
-Prismatic Shards can now be placed in Crystalariums. Can be affected by the Faster Minerals settings but only if newly placed Prismatic Shards are placed inside a Crystalarium.

[u][b]Omni Geode Prismatic Shards[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will determine the chance that Prismatic Shards can be produced from Omni Geodes. Ranges from 1% to 99%.

[u][b]Minerals Sell Value[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the sell value of all minerals. This includes minerals obtained from all geodes! Ranges from 10% to 500% increase. Please note, enabling or disabling these settings will only pertain to newly acquired minerals after the setting you want is enabled!

[u][b]Ore And Bars Sell Value[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will increase the sell value of all ore and bars. Ranges from 10% to 500% increase. Please note, enabling or disabling these settings will only pertain to newly acquired ore and bars after the setting you want is enabled![/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]BLACKSMITH'S SHOP ADDITIONS AND PRICES

[/b][/u][/size][/color][size=3][b][u]Blacksmith Open All Days
[/u][/b]-Clint's Blacksmith Shop will now be open every day, except for special event days.[/size]

[size=3][u][b]Blacksmith's Ore Prices[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the price of all ore in Clint's Blacksmith Shop. Ranges from 10% to 99% decrease.

[u][b]Blacksmith's Iridium Ore[/b][/u]
-Clint's Blacksmith Shop now sells Iridium Ore. Can be affected by the Blacksmith's Ore Prices setting above.

[u][b]Blacksmith's Machinery (REQ)[/b][/u]
-Clint's Blacksmith Shop now sells Furnaces, Charcoal Kilns, Crystalariums, and Geode Crushers. This setting is required for the Blacksmith Machinery settings below!

[u][b]Blacksmith's Machinery Availability[/b][/u]
-All machinery in Clint's Blacksmith Shop will be available right away without reaching certain level conditions. Requires the Blacksmith's Machinery Prices (REQ) setting to work!

[u][b]Blacksmith's Machinery Prices[/b][/u]
-Clint's Blacksmith Shop now sells Furnaces, Charcoal Kilns, Crystalariums, and Geode Crushers. Ranges from 10% to 99% decrease. Requires the Blacksmith's Machinery Prices (REQ) setting to work![/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]DWARF'S SHOP ADDITIONS AND PRICES[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][b][u]Dwarf's Bomb Prices[/u][/b]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the price of all bombs in Dwarf's Shop. Ranges from 10% to 99% decrease.

[u][b]Dwarf's Monster Musk (REQ)[/b][/u]
-Adds the Monster Musk item to Dwarf's Shop after completing Level 120 of the mines. Monster Musk is an up that spawns more enemies on a map. This setting is required for the Monster Musk settings below!

[u][b]Dwarf's Monster Musk Condition[/b][/u]
-Removes the condition for unlocking the Monster Musk item in Dwarf's Shop. Requires the Dwarf's Monster Musk (REQ) setting to work!

[u][b]Dwarf's Monster Musk Price[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the price of Monster Musk in Dwarf's Shop. Ranges from 4000g to 1g. Requires the Dwarf's Monster Musk (REQ) setting to work![/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]TRAVELER'S SHOP ADDITIONS AND PRICES[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3][u][b]Travel Magic Rock Candy (REQ)[/b][/u]
-Adds the Magic Rock Candy food item to the Traveling Cart every Friday after completing Level 120 of the mines and have a Combat and Mining skill of Level 10. This setting is required for the Magic Rock Candy settings below!

[u][b]Travel Magic Rock Candy Conditions[/b][/u]
-Removes the conditions for unlocking the Magic Rock Candy food item for the Traveling Cart Merchant. Requires the Traveling Magic Rock Candy (REQ) setting to work!

[u][b]Travel Magic Rock Candy Price[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the price of Magic Rock Candy for the Traveling Cart Merchant. Ranges from 20000g to 1g. Requires the Traveling Magic Rock Candy (REQ) setting to work![/size]

[color=#e69138][size=4][u][b]ADVENTURER SHOP ADDITIONS AND PRICES

[/b][/u][/size][/color][b][u][size=3]Monster Eradication Goals[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]-Choose a setting that will decrease the requirement to meet the Monster Eradication Goals at the Adventurer's Guild. Ranges from 10% to 99% decrease.[/size]

[size=3][u][b]Adventurer's Guild Shop Prices[/b][/u]
-Choose a setting that will decrease the price of all Weapons, Rings, and Boots in the Adventurer's Guild shop. Ranges from 10% to 99% decrease.[/size]
[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/h30zGWL.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#ffff00]1. [/color]The item drop rate settings will NOT affect the Haunted Skull and Pepper Rex monsters. (The skulls in the Quarry Mines and Dinos)

[color=#ffff00]2.[/color] The Lava Lurk monster in the Volcano Dungeon is not affected by the Decreases Damage from Monsters, Speed, and Detection from Monsters settings.

[color=#ffff00]3.[/color] All Flying Monsters are unaffected by the Decreased Movement Speed settings.

[color=#ffff00]4.[/color] Using the Minerals Sell Value settings affect ALL minerals which also include the minerals you obtain from geodes.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/afNk7oS.png[/img]

You can adjust the difficulty (easy or hard options), availability (time, seasons, and weather), spawn rates, and value of fish. Other features include; ability to recatch legendary fish, making Prismatic Shards a fishable item, and MUCH more![/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4130][b][size=5][u]Farming Made Easy Suite[/u][/size][/b][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4130]

Other features include; Faster maturing for farm animals, build Greenhouses from Robin, and MUCH more![/size][size=3][color=#ffff00][size=3]

Downloads.Description: Requires Stardew Valley v1.6! Be sure to install the required mods! Then extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. To enable a setting, click on the cog wheel on the Stardew Valley title screen. All settings for the mod will be there!

Manifest.Name: Combat Made Easy Suite
Manifest.Description: Customizes your combat experience in Stardew Valley. You can enable settings from the cog wheel on the Stardew Valley title screen on the bottom left. Refer to the INSTRUCTIONS & INFO document included for more information.
Manifest.Author: Ericlegacy
